But even so, I really wanted to upload this video.

Many of you enjoy my retrospective videos and look forward to them every year, and even though it's a bit late right now,

I thought it might be helpful to someone in the long run!

I'll bring you stories about getting a job soon...🙃💫

Stay healthy everyone until then🤍

(It was January when we filmed, so the Dubai series was super hot,

but the trend passed by so fast...😭😭)
